text:
maria: @auditor_james quick follow-up from today's remote SOC2 call — can you confirm the exact evidence items you want for the RBAC change we merged on 2024-08-04? we want to bundle PR + approvals + infra logs + any incident triage notes.

auditor_james: hi maria — list would be: 1) PR link + commit hash 2) approval audit (who approved + timestamp) 3) k8s rolebinding diff + apply events 4) CloudTrail/KMS events for the change window 5) any SIEM/alert screenshots and triage notes 6) chain-of-custody for exported artifacts. thanks.

maria: copy. PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 (commit abc1234). approvals recorded via SSO GitHub org. i'll export the approval log via GH API and include it. rolebinding diffs live in infra/iam/rolebindings/*.yaml — will attach snapshots.

owen: for KMS -> we log kms:Encrypt kms:Decrypt GenerateDataKey and KeyUsage in CloudTrail. sample lookup I use: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 --start-time 2024-08-03T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-08-05T23:59:59Z`

owen: can export results to s3://redwood-audit-exports/2689012345/kms-events.json and we'll include the raw and a CSV summary.

kelsey: retention notes: CloudTrail raw in S3 = 24 months, Snowflake indexed logs = 13 months. exports will include both raw and redacted copies. we redact display names and service tokens in the redacted bundle. auditor_james — do you need both redacted and unredacted?

auditor_james: we need both — unredacted must be access-controlled. also include a short chain-of-custody statement saying who pulled the export and when.

maria: will do. bundle contents plan: 1) PR + commit + GH approval export 2) rolebinding yaml before/after diffs 3) CloudTrail KMS events + S3 link 4) SIEM screenshots + timelines 5) incident triage notes (if any alerts) 6) chain-of-custody manifest signed by sec lead. aiming to have initial bundle by EOD Friday.

auditor_james: pls include the incident playbook used for triage too (we want to see the steps taken).

maria: playbook path: `confluence://sec/incident-response/rbac-kms` — i'll snapshot the page and include a PDF.

owen: quick note on reproducing the k8s audit extract: ```kubectl logs -n kube-system audit-collector-7d9b4c5 | jq '. | select(.objectRef.name=="team-rolebinding-prod")' > /tmp/rbac-audit-sample.json``` use `--since` on the logging agent for time ranges.

infra-bot: artifact-export: /artifacts/audits/2024-08-07/rbac-kms-evidence-bundle-2689012345.tar.gz uploaded by maria at 2024-08-07T16:12:00Z :white_check_mark:

kelsey: note for auditors — redaction method: user.displayName redacted, principalId truncated to last 8 chars; timestamps preserved in UTC. full unredacted copy available on request under RBAC-akeyed access workflow.

auditor_james: :thumbsup: that's great. one final ask — include all timestamps in UTC and mention any timezone conversions in a README.

maria: will add README with UTC-confirmation + exact commands used to generate exports. i'll also tag owners for each artifact in the bundle (maria for PR/approval, owen for CloudTrail/KMS, kelsey for retention/chain-of-custody).

kelsey: pinging @compliance to remind them to approve the controlled export request once the bundle is ready.

auditor_james: thanks team, this should cover our audit requests. i'll check the bundle when ready and follow up if anything's missing.

maria: thanks — will update this thread when the export is staged.
